name: python-single-flight
title: Python single-flight cache
blurb: A TTL cache where concurrent misses for one key run the loader exactly once: waiters share the answer or the same error, failures are never cached, and a slow key cannot hold up an unrelated one.
default_description: One loader run per key, never one per caller.
next_steps: uv venv --quiet --allow-existing .venv && uv pip install --quiet --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff
